subject: pharmacology
title: Antifungals: azoles, amphotericin and echinocandins

steps.tx: **Azoles** (lanosterol demethylase blockade) share **CYP inhibition** (warfarin, statin, QT with macrolides) with **hepatotoxicity**; **fluconazole** (candida, crypto maintenance, single dose vulvovaginitis, renal dosed) is safest systemically, **itraconazole** (ABPA, histo, blasto; **negative inotrope banning heart failure**, levels with absorption acidic) needs monitoring, **voriconazole** (invasive aspergillus first line, **visual halos**, skin cancer chronic, CYP2C19 levels) watches eyes and liver. Acne-like rashes with LFTs gate.
steps.say: Azoles inhibit CYP and injure liver: fluconazole safest, itraconazole fails hearts, voriconazole halos vision. Levels guide.

steps.tx: **Posaconazole** (AML and GVHD **prophylaxis**, mucor step down, QT with GI upset) and **isavuconazole** (aspergillus with mucor, **shortens QT** uniquely, fewer interactions) modernise mould cover; therapeutic drug monitoring targets prophylaxis versus treatment. Breakthrough (non-aspergillus moulds, resistance) switches class; surgical debridement pairs mucor. Suspension versus tablet absorption differs critically.
steps.say: AML mould shield is posaconazole; QT shortening mould drug is isavuconazole. Breakthrough switches class.

steps.tx: **Amphotericin B** (ergosterol pores, broadest including mucor and crypto, **infusion reactions** with rigors, **nephrotoxicity** with hypokalaemia and hypomagnesaemia, anaemia) is tamed by **liposomal** formulation (less renal, costlier) with saline loading and slow infusion; test doses debated. **Flucytosine** (crypto combo with ampho, **marrow suppression** with levels in renal failure) never solos (resistance); prehydration with electrolyte repletion sustains courses.
steps.say: Rigoring febrile infusion with failing kidneys is amphotericin: liposomal tames, saline loads. Flucytosine never solos.

steps.tx: **Echinocandins** (**caspofungin, micafungin, anidulafungin**: beta-glucan wall, candidaemia with empiric neutropenic fever, **no crypto, CNS or urine** cover, histamine flushing) bridge azole resistance; **terbinafine** (**nail onychomycosis** with LFTs, taste loss, drug interactions few) beats griseofulvin (tinea capitis children, photosensitivity, warfarin boost). **Nystatin** (thrush swish, no absorption) with clotrimazole vulvovaginitis finish topicals.
steps.say: Candidaemia empiric neutropenic is echinocandin (never crypto or urine). Nails terbinafine with LFTs; kids ringworm griseofulvin.
